haqes.title: HAQES ensemble mean (GMU/NASA)
haqes.source: GES DISC HAQES_NA_PM25_{TOT,OC,BC} v1 (data.gesdisc.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/HAQAST, Earthdata login)
haqes.notes: 12 km North America, 3-hourly ensemble mean of GEOS, NAAPS, GEFS-Aerosols, HRRR-Smoke and NACC-CMAQ (next-day forecast). Partly dependent on AirNow via the NACC-CMAQ bias correction.

naqfc.title: NOAA NAQFC/AQM (raw)
naqfc.source: s3://noaa-nws-naqfc-pds AQMv5/v6/v7 CS ave_1hr_{pm25,o3} (12z cycle, f01-f24)
naqfc.notes: 5 km CONUS (grid 227); CMAQ (v5/v6) then UFS-AQM (v7, 2024-05-14). Forecast hours 1-24 of the 12 UTC cycle joined; no surface observations assimilated.

naqfc_bc.title: NOAA NAQFC/AQM (bias-corrected)
naqfc_bc.source: s3://noaa-nws-naqfc-pds AQMv5/v6/v7 CS ave_1hr_{pm25,o3}_bc (12z cycle, f01-f24)
naqfc_bc.notes: Bias-corrected NAQFC (analog/Kalman correction trained on AirNow observations: not independent of AQS/AirNow). Forecast hours 1-24 of the 12 UTC cycle joined.

acag.title: ACAG V6.GL.03 (+V6.NA.01 composition)
acag.source: s3://satpmdata (WashU ACAG; V6GL03 global, V6NA01 North America composition), anonymous
acag.notes: 0.01 deg monthly means labelled at the 1st of the month; CNN calibrated to ground monitors
acag.dependence: calibrated to ground monitors (global); NA composition uses speciation networks

ghap.title: GHAP GlobalHighPM2.5 V2 daily 1 km
ghap.source: Zenodo GlobalHighPM2.5 per-year records (D1K monthly zips), one range request per day
ghap.notes: 0.01 deg daily (UTC day) PM2.5 over land; ML trained on ground monitors (not independent)
ghap.dependence: trained on ~9,500 monitors (OpenAQ, EPA, EEA, CNEMC)

ghap_m.title: GHAP GlobalHighPM2.5 V2 monthly 1 km
ghap_m.source: Zenodo GlobalHighPM2.5 per-year records (M1K monthly NetCDF)
ghap_m.notes: 0.01 deg monthly PM2.5 labelled at the 1st of the month; ML trained on ground monitors
ghap_m.dependence: trained on ~9,500 monitors (OpenAQ, EPA, EEA, CNEMC)

hrrr_smoke.title: HRRR-Smoke (HRRRv4 analysis)
hrrr_smoke.source: dynamical.org noaa-hrrr-analysis-virtual v0.1.0 Icechunk (virtual refs to s3://noaa-hrrr-bdp-pds wrfsfcf00 GRIB2), variable mass_density_8m
hrrr_smoke.notes: 3 km CONUS. Near-surface (8 m) smoke mass density from fire emissions only (not total PM2.5); instantaneous analysis value at the stamp. Starts with HRRRv4 (2020-12-02).

pm25_smoke.desc: HRRR near-surface (8 m) smoke PM2.5, instantaneous

geoscf_v1.title: GEOS-CF v1 (replay)
geoscf_v1.notes: 0.25 deg hourly; PM2.5 at 35% RH (pm25_rh35_gcc); no surface obs assimilated

geoscf_v2.title: GEOS-CF v2 (replay)
geoscf_v2.notes: 0.25 deg hourly; PM at 35% RH; satellite O3 assimilated, no surface obs

merra2.title: MERRA-2 aerosols (M2T1NXAER)
merra2.source: GES DISC M2T1NXAER.5.12.4 daily files via Earthdata HTTPS (range reads of 7 variables)
merra2.notes: 0.5x0.625 deg hourly; dry mass, no nitrate; PM2.5 = DU25+SS25+BC+1.4*OC+SO4*132.14/96.06; AOD assimilated, no surface PM

pm25_oc.desc: organic carbon as carried by GOCART

merra2_cnn.title: MERRA-2 CNN HAQAST bias-corrected PM2.5
merra2_cnn.source: GES DISC MERRA2_CNN_HAQAST_PM25.1 daily files via Earthdata HTTPS
merra2_cnn.notes: 0.5x0.625 deg hourly; CNN ensemble trained on >5000 OpenAQ reference monitors (not independent of AirNow/AQS/embassy data)
merra2_cnn.dependence: trained on OpenAQ reference monitors (incl. AQS/AirNow, embassies)

merra2_gmi.title: MERRA-2 GMI aerosols (full chemistry, with nitrate)
merra2_gmi.notes: 0.5x0.625 deg hourly; MERRA-2 met replay + GMI chemistry; PM25 = total reconstructed PM2.5 incl. nitrate/NH4

geosfp_aer.title: GEOS-FP aerosols (tavg3_2d_aer_Nx)
geosfp_aer.notes: 0.25x0.3125 deg, 3-hourly means; GOCART dry mass, PM2.5 = DU25+SS25+BC+1.4*OC+SO4*132.14/96.06 (nitrate stored separately); MODIS AOD assimilated, no surface PM
